purpose.value: The website positions this product for sandalwood-scented body cleansing.
purpose.note: Positioning only; not an approved efficacy claim.

ingredients.value: Crafted with organic extra virgin olive oil, organic palm oil (fair trade sustainable), organic coconut oil (fair trade), and organic shea butter, ensuring that every bar is as kind to the planet as it is to your skin. • Versatile Skincare Solution: A perfect addition to any skincare regimen, this soap's rich lather and moisturizing properties make it suitable for daily use on all skin types. Ingredients: Ingredients: Saponified Oils (Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Organic Palm Oil, Organic Coconut Oil, Organic Shea Butter), Fragrance

directions.value: Add warm water for a thick lather. Keep dry between uses for extended longevity.

protocol.value:
1
Wet skin and bar with warm water.
2
Lather directly in hands or with a washcloth.
3
Massage over the body.
4
Rinse thoroughly and store the bar in a dry place between uses.
Use daily in the shower as the warm sandalwood body-cleansing step of the Legacy Reserve standard.

safety.value: In case of accidental contact with eyes, immediately rinse thoroughly with clean water. If irritation occurs, discontinue use.
